sentences.text:
Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus by directing the respondents not to dispossess the petitioners from (Arazi No. 711), Plot No.37 Area 94.06 square meter, Plot No. 36 Area 41.805 Square meter, Plot No. 4 Area 132.38 square meter, Plot No. 31 Area 125.415 square meter, Plot No. 28 Area 104.51 square meter, Plot No. 21 Area 112.88 Square meter, Plot No. 2 Area 150.83 square meter,
Plot No.1 (Part) Area 95.42 square meter situated at Village Singhpur Kachhar Tehsil and District Kanpur Nagar.
ii. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to provide the plots of same area to the petitioners in New Kanpur City Scheme or pay compensation to the petitioners under "THE RIGHT TO FAIR C O M P E N S A T I O N A N D T R A N S P A R E N C Y I N L A N D A C Q U I S I T I O N ,
REHABILIATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT, 2013."
2. The admitted facts are that the Kanpur Development Authority has proposed a scheme for development of new Kanpur City.
The plot in question falls in the midst of the scheme.

The Kanpur Development Authority has already succeeded in obtaining sale deed from large number of surrounding land owners but the petitioners have refused to execute the sale deed in favour of Kanpur Development Authority.

3. Learned Standing Counsel has placed on record the instructions received from ADM, Land Acquisition, Kanpur Nagar, according to which a proposal has been received by him from Kanpur Development Authority for acquisition of the subject land.

4. Sri A.P. Paul, learned counsel appearing for Kanpur Development Authority states that Kanpur Development Authority will not interfere in the possession of the petitioner unless they obtain valid title over the same either by obtaining sale deed through mutual negotiation or by way of compulsory acquisition.
5. This in our opinion amply safeguards the interest of the petitioner.
The petition is accordingly stands disposed of in terms of the stand taken by Sri A.P. Paul, learned counsel for the respondent Development Authority.

Shubham Arya (Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
